title: Divider
description: x-divider marks its host as a separator (role="separator"). With a label (the text between the tags, or text) and not vertical, it rebuilds the host as a rule, the label, and a rule.

text.description: Label shown in the middle of the rule. The text between the tags wins; this fills an empty host. Ignored when vertical is set.

vertical.description: A vertical separator, for a row of items. Bare attribute. A vertical divider shows no label.

_metadata.derivedFrom: feedback.js divider() — every property here is one the behavior reads
